name: Infinite Slider
summary: Animated infinite-looping slider component for React, horizontal or vertical, with speed and hover-speed props.
description: Docs page for the InfiniteSlider component of Motion-Primitives: an infinite scrolling slider that smoothly loops through its children, in horizontal or vertical direction, with gap, speed and speed-on-hover props. It ships basic, hover-speed and vertical examples, installation instructions (Tailwind CSS, Motion, Lucide icons, or copying the code by hand) and the component API.
contains: infinite scrolling slider that loops its children
installed by command or by copying the code
built for React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS
